method: exact rational cell enumeration of the speed-simplex outcome arrangement
key_fact: speeds Exp(1) iid are invariant to common scaling; normalized speeds uniform on (n-1)-simplex (Dirichlet(1,..,1)); p(n,L) = (n-1)! * (Euclidean volume of even-parity cells)
separators: candidate event times F_j=(L-40j)/v_j [finish], C_ab=40(b-a)/(v_a-v_b) [catch]; each is const/(linear), so pairwise equalities are affine hyperplanes; speed equalities v_a=v_b affine too -> genuine straight-line arrangement; parity constant on open cells (verified: 0 inconsistent sign-buckets in 150k samples per config)

exact_values.p(5,1800): MC only: 0.53273 +/- 0.00029 (3M samples); exact arrangement infeasible with naive vertex solver (85 hyperplanes in 4-simplex, ~13750 cells)

n=5 note: exact n=5 arrangement enumerated to 13,750 distinct nonempty cells by sampling (200k); a full exact sum over ~14k cells with the naive per-cell vertex solver would take several hours — left as MC estimate per steering.
